app.name: Muslim Plus
app.build: git 7a771a1 + uncommitted working tree (vite dev, web)

cases.title: Location step offers three setup options
preconditions: Fresh browser profile / app data cleared
steps: Wait for the splash screen to finish
expected_result: Step indicator 'STEP 1 OF 3' is shown
Buttons 'Use phone location', 'Skip for now' and 'Select city manually' are visible

cases.title: Manual city search returns selectable results
preconditions: Fresh browser profile / app data cleared
Network access to the city-search service
steps: On Location Setup tap 'Select city manually'
Tap the result 'Kochi – Ernakulam District, Kerala, India'
expected_result: A 'Searching...' state is shown while loading
A result list containing 'Ernakulam District, Kerala, India' appears
After selection a card shows 'Kochi' with a 'Change' action and a 'Continue' button

cases.title: City result list is not overlapped by the step dots
preconditions: Fresh browser profile / app data cleared
steps: Inspect the result cards near the step-indicator dots
expected_result: No result card text is covered by the pagination/step dots

cases.title: Madhab step requires a selection and marks it
preconditions: Fresh browser profile / app data cleared
Location step completed
steps: Observe the Continue button before selecting
expected_result: Continue appears disabled before a selection
After tapping, Hanafi shows a filled radio indicator
Continue becomes enabled

cases.title: Completing setup lands on the dashboard with chosen city
preconditions: Fresh browser profile / app data cleared
Location and madhab steps completed
expected_result: The Home dashboard is displayed
Header reads 'TODAY'S DATE • KOCHI'

cases.title: Onboarding is not repeated after reload
preconditions: Onboarding completed with city Kochi (Kerala, India), any madhab, gender Female
expected_result: The Home dashboard is shown, not Location Setup

cases.title: Dashboard shows dates and next prayer countdown
preconditions: Onboarding completed with city Kochi (Kerala, India), any madhab, gender Female
steps: Wait 3 seconds and re-read the countdown
expected_result: Gregorian date matching the device date is shown
A Hijri date with 'AH' is shown
Next prayer name and time are shown
Countdown value decreases over time

cases.title: Dashboard tiles open their features
preconditions: Onboarding completed with city Kochi (Kerala, India), any madhab, gender Female
steps: Tap each tile in turn (Quran, Prayer Times, Qibla Finder, Tasbih, Duas, Calendar), returning Home after each
expected_result: Each tile opens the matching screen (/quran, /prayer, /qibla, /tasbih, /duas, /calendar)

cases.title: Bottom navigation routes to each tab
preconditions: Onboarding completed with city Kochi (Kerala, India), any madhab, gender Female
steps: Tap Home, Quran, Tasbih, Qibla, more in the bottom bar (back to Home between full-screen tabs)
expected_result: Each tab opens its screen without errors in the console

cases.title: Unknown route does not crash the app
preconditions: Onboarding completed with city Kochi (Kerala, India), any madhab, gender Female
expected_result: A usable screen (Home or a not-found page) renders; no blank page or error boundary

cases.title: All prayer rows are legible, including the next prayer
preconditions: Onboarding completed with city Kochi (Kerala, India), any madhab, gender Female
Light mode
Time is before Isha so one row is 'next'
steps: Inspect each of the six rows
expected_result: Rows Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha each show a readable name and time
The next-prayer row is visually highlighted but its text is readable

cases.title: Changing madhab updates Asr and persists
preconditions: Onboarding completed with city Kochi (Kerala, India), any madhab, gender Female
steps: Select 'Shafi', close the sheet, note Asr
expected_result: Asr time for Hanafi is later than for Shafi
Summary chip shows the selected madhab
Selection survives reload

cases.title: Sura list shows all 114 suras
preconditions: Onboarding completed with city Kochi (Kerala, India), any madhab, gender Female
steps: Scroll to the end of the list
expected_result: First item is 1 Al-Faatiha (7 Ayah)
Last item is 114 An-Naas
Each item shows English meaning, ayah count and Arabic name

cases.title: Opening a surah shows ayahs and both view modes work

cases.title: Floating Read Mode button does not hide verse text

Al-Faatiha open in Reading view at top
steps: Observe the floating 'READ MODE' button position relative to ayah text

cases.title: Tapping increments and Reset clears the counter
